ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Nonprofit Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate nonprofit fraud schemes, including the Feeding Our Future investigation, to uncover the scope and severity of the problem.
questions: What are the most common types of nonprofit fraud?
How can nonprofit organizations prevent fraud and abuse?
ideas.insight: This story idea has the potential to uncover widespread nonprofit fraud and abuse, and to provide insights into the causes and consequences of such schemes.
